title: F8: frame and flood budget
outcome: Bounded reader and per-connection denial budget with auto conn suspend
acceptance: Reader takes at most MAX_FRAME_BYTES+1; oversize -> deny/schema with raw_hash over the prefix, connection closed
K recorded denials per conn per tick, then Control{suspend, conn:<id>, reason=flood} by ks.gateway and close; agent not suspended
A 10k-frame flood adds at most K+1 records per tick and no witness stall (test)
summary: Gateway.tick: FLOOD_K=8 recorded denials/conn/tick; surplus frames dropped+counted (flood_dropped), one Control{suspend conn:<id>, reason=flood, ks.gateway} via admit_system (agent untouched); barrier.py closes gateway.flooded conns (3-line edit). Reader bound/oversize deny-schema already existed (pop_frame/fill). Nits: pii extra recipients (cc/bcc/...) fail closed, lowercase IBANs, MANUAL_UNHOLD removed. Tests tests/gateway/test_flood.py; env 932 passed; container not run.
review: [kabir · done] Done (reviewer kabir). Ran: env 946 passed/3 failed (all tests/runtime/test_recover.py, B3-48 in-flight, pass in isolation, not B3-32); container 957 passed; make smoke OK (anchored, per_agent_uid). Attacks: (1) Reconnect: none possible; conns are fixed socketpairs made at spawn (run.py:188), no accept path, so a closed conn stays closed and per-agent records are bounded at K+1 once. (2) Crowd-out: only of the flooder's own later frames that tick; test_honest_conn_unaffected covers other agents; garbage is schema-denied cheaply before sig work. (3) In the real runtime the budget never fires: barrier C2 passes one frame per conn per tick (CALL-02 C2), and CALL-02 deferred F8b for exactly that reason. So this is defense-in-depth for direct Gateway.tick callers, consistent with ADR-04 RT11 'floods suspend only the connection'. Not suspending the agent is correct (garbage is attributed_agent=None and could be forged). Nits landed: lowercase IBAN (tested), MANUAL_UNHOLD gone from holds.py, cc/bcc fail closed. Non-blocking: no test for cc/bcc; only top-level keys are checked (nested headers.cc is not); state in the ADR-03/04 text that F8b is a backstop, not the primary bound.
